revision.description: Document revision after a successful save, or the current revision when the save was refused.

errorCode.description: Stable failure code. revision.conflict means the document moved on since it was read; re-read before saving again.

errors.description: Error messages when the save could not be performed, e.g. invalid game root/slug or missing project; non-empty ⇒ ok=false, nothing written.

validation.description: ValidationSummary for the accepted document revision.

versions.description: Reserved compatibility field. Successful saves currently return an empty array.
